digest.component_or_area: outbound-parent reconciliation, CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback
propositions: CREATE emit of a ticket with a non-epic parent drops the parent silently with only a logger.debug, leaving no durable bridge_alerts record.
ACLI attach fallback swallows HTTP 400 on set_parent with a WARNING log but never calls record_parent_divergence, leaving the parent rejection unrecorded.
The suppressed_out keyword-only parameter must be threaded through OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote and _compute_outbound_create_mutation to report dropped parents to dropped_field_sink.
UNBOUND parents must not be reported as suppressed, because they converge on a later pass and alerting would be churn.

The epic-only parent guard is unconditional on both Cloud and Data Center; Cloud 400s a non-epic parent while Data Center silently ignores it, so the guard is justified on both but for different reasons.
